beats.headline: Take the golem
beats.text: Signet is gone, and not all of her tattoos were warriors. Beside the crying boy Clint and Miss Nadine lies a naiad with her eyes closed as if sleeping: Signet's mother, or the memory of her given flesh. Princess Lunette. Incomplete Flesh Golem. Samantha pokes her with a burned head and calls her cousin. Nadine, breathless, says Signet wants Carl to take it; she took the memory with her and left just the body. Help Samantha. Find a pulpmancer. It weighs nothing and has no dot on the map. Carl pulls it into his inventory, and Samantha shoots off down a hole in the floor.

beats.headline: A body on the asphalt
beats.text: Samantha insists the spider in the trees can cast the spell that will put her into the golem. Carl pulls the body from his inventory, rigid as a board: a full-sized, pure naiad in a flowing dress of seaweed, smelling of brackish water, weightless, her silky white hair so long it reaches the pavement. Before Signet's final spell it was a tattoo of a fish. He lays it on the wet asphalt, and Samantha floats up, shaking with excitement. Shi Maria clicks and gestures at the body. She needs supplies first.

beats.headline: Good heart, good lungs
beats.text: Epitome Tagg is in Louis's heart and lungs, and when the soldiers take the Dream castle within the hour, Tagg will die and take Louis with him. Samantha knows how to save Louis. The flesh golem body in Carl's inventory, Princess Lunette, has a good heart and lungs; swap them out fast enough and he lives. Mordecai calls it a great idea. Edgar remembers that the body was his tattoo first, before Signet turned it into an incomplete flesh golem. Baroness Victory warns that it will not work outside the dungeon, and Louis will need an expensive deal to survive.

beats.headline: Heart and lungs out
beats.text: Carl dumps the body on a cot beside Louis. It is a slight, beautiful naiad, and it has gills, so Mordecai takes the kua-tin rebreather Carl looted from Loita. Imani and Rosetta open the golem up, and with Elle they hold its dripping heart and lungs up in a net. When Louis's heart stops, Bucket Boy yanks the old organs out, Imani places the new ones, Juice Box casts, and Mordecai sews the rebreather into the bronchial. The chest snaps shut. Louis coughs water from new gills and opens his eyes.
